title: Bullpen says unauthorized transfers hit early-beta accounts; Ansem says his Pump wallet was hacked
date_note: Both articles are dated 24 November and give no earlier day.
summary: Ansem said his Pump wallet was hacked. Decrypt reports Bullpen said it identified "unauthorized transfers involving Bullpen accounts opened during our early beta between April and June 2024", including Ansem's. The Currency Analytics reports Bullpen said the known impact was limited to 19 early beta accounts and that it is working with the FBI. Analysts such as MLM, quoted by Decrypt and Wikitree, say the activity does not look like a hack.
plain: Bullpen says it found unauthorized transfers on early-beta accounts, including Ansem's; The Currency Analytics reports it says the known impact was limited to 19 accounts. Some analysts say the on-chain activity does not look like a hack.
exec: Bullpen has acknowledged unauthorized transfers on early-beta accounts, with known impact limited to 19 accounts per The Currency Analytics; analysts dispute that Ansem's sales were a hack.
